Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely anchored on Meir Teper as “the” producer of Mistress based on a search snippet, without verifying the full producer list from authoritative sources. This led to an incorrect narrowing of the search (only checking Meir Teper’s acting in The Godfather and restricting focus to The Godfather (1972) instead of considering The Godfather Part II and other producers like Robert De Niro). The Planner then repeated nearly identical instructions to WebSurfer multiple times without refining the strategy or disambiguating multiple “Mistress” films or producer credits, resulting in stagnation and a likely wrong direction.
